messages.subject: difference between scale_x_continuous and xlab
parts:
I have used following code to label the x axis.

library(ggplot2);library(mlmRev)
p <- qplot(sample=gcsescore, data = Chem97,stat='qq')
p
p + scale_x_continuous("City mpg")
p + xlab("City mpg")

I do not know why xlab() to not work, the label remain unchanged. The
scale_x_continuous() function works.
